title: 5. MITRE ATT&CK — Structure & Tactics
objective: Study-guide review — ICCS423 v2 — L21: Threat Intelligence & MITRE ATT&CK: 5. MITRE ATT&CK — Structure & Tactics.

items: MITRE ATT&CK = Adversarial Tactics, Techniques, and Common Knowledge
Curated, globally-accessible knowledge base of adversary behavior, built from real-world observations
Created by MITRE (US non-profit FFRDC); released publicly 2015; free + open use (CC BY-SA)
Core idea: describe attacks by behaviors (tactics + techniques), not static signatures

rows: Windows, macOS, Linux, cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP/M365), network infra, containers

blocks.text: `` Tactic (TA0001 — Initial Access) └── Technique (T1566 — Phishing) └── Sub-technique (T1566.001 — Spearphishing Attachment) └── Procedure (specific implementation) ``
Important: tactics are NOT strictly sequential. Attackers loop (Discovery → Lateral Movement → Discovery again) and skip phases.
